title: 第 331 章 番外30
slug: 成婚不圆房重生娇娇不嫁他急了
content_zh:
但是最近靠近荆州和潜阳区域的几个安全区，陆陆续续都受到了很多袭击，损失的很多人。
只有叶家人和骆天以及卓氏集团的竞争对手们，看到卓潇依的行为，脸上不约而同挂起了，不怀好意的笑容。
也不去管外面最后的结果是怎么样？家里米面都是他娘管着的，怎么也饿不着他们。
姜云不知道该怎么回答自己的父亲，现在大仇未报，还出现了一个可以逆天改命的至宝，让姜云放弃，这属实是太过于为难他了。
content_en:
However, several safety zones near Jingzhou and Qianyang areas have been attacked one after another recently, and many people have been lost.
Only the Ye family, Luo Tian and Zhuo Group's competitors saw Zhuo Xiaoyi's behavior and invariably put on malicious smiles on their faces.
Don't care what the final result will be outside? His mother was in charge of the rice and noodles at home, so they could never starve.
Jiang Yun didn't know how to answer his father. Now that the great revenge had not been avenged, and a treasure that could change one's fate appeared, it was too difficult for Jiang Yun to give up.
